HD.HD-02: #Đọc hướng dẫn ở bên dưới nội dung

HD.HD-03: Nội dung với bộ cục 4 phần!

My best friend Anna is a cheerful and kind girl from my class. She has long black hair, bright eyes, and a warm smile that makes people feel welcome. She is always ready to help others and share her lunch with friends. I feel lucky to have her as a friend who supports me in everything.

I have a lovely white cat named Snow who lives in my house. Her fur is soft and fluffy, and she has beautiful blue eyes that shine in the sunlight. She enjoys playing with a small ball and sleeping on my bed. Snow makes me feel happy and calm whenever I spend time with her.

My school is a large building located near the center of our town. It has tall windows, colorful walls, and a big playground where students play during breaks. The teachers are friendly and always encourage us to do our best in every subject. I enjoy going to school because it is a place full of learning and friendship.

There is a peaceful park near my house where I often go in the afternoon. The park has green grass, tall trees, and a small pond with ducks swimming. Many families come here to walk, have picnics, or play games together. I love this park because it gives me fresh air and a relaxing feeling.

My bicycle is a bright red mountain bike that I use every weekend. It has strong wheels, a comfortable seat, and a small basket in the front. I usually ride it to the park or along the river to enjoy the view. This bicycle is special to me because my father gave it to me on my birthday.

My favorite teacher is Mr. Brown, who teaches us English every Monday and Wednesday. He is tall, wears glasses, and always dresses neatly in a blue shirt. He explains lessons clearly and tells funny stories to make the class enjoyable. I respect him a lot because he inspires me to study harder and improve my English.

My grandmother is an old but very strong woman who lives in the countryside. She has short grey hair, gentle eyes, and a warm smile. She loves gardening and often gives us fresh vegetables from her garden. I admire her because she works hard and always cares for her family.

My bedroom is small but cozy, with light blue walls and a wooden floor. There is a soft bed near the window, and a desk where I do my homework. I decorated the walls with posters of my favorite singers and places. This room is my favorite place because I can relax and be myself there.

My favorite book is a story about a young boy who travels the world. The cover is colorful, with pictures of mountains, rivers, and beautiful cities. The story teaches me about courage, friendship, and following my dreams. I enjoy reading it again and again because it inspires me to explore new places.

My town is a quiet place surrounded by green fields and small hills. The streets are clean, and there are many flowers along the sidewalks. People here are friendly and always greet each other with a smile. I love my town because it feels safe and peaceful every day.

My smartphone is black with a large screen and a strong camera. I use it to call my friends, take photos, and listen to music. It helps me learn English through online lessons and practice tests. This phone is very important to me because it connects me with people I love.

My favorite singer is a young woman with a powerful and emotional voice. She often wears beautiful dresses and sings songs that touch people’s hearts. Her music gives me hope and makes me feel less stressed. I listen to her songs almost every day because they make me happy.

My garden is behind my house, full of colorful flowers and green plants. There is a small path between the rows of roses and sunflowers. I spend my weekends watering the plants and removing weeds. This garden makes me proud because I created it with my own hands.

My favorite food is spaghetti with tomato sauce and melted cheese on top. The noodles are soft, and the sauce is rich and flavorful. My mother cooks it for me on special days when I do well at school. I love it because it tastes delicious and reminds me of happy family dinners.

My laptop is silver, light, and easy to carry in my backpack. I use it for studying, watching videos, and writing school essays. It has a fast processor and a clear screen, which makes work easier. This laptop is special because I saved money for a year to buy it myself.

There is a beautiful beach near my uncle’s house where we go in summer. The sand is soft, the water is clear, and the waves are gentle. Families come here to swim, build sandcastles, and enjoy the sunset. I love the beach because it makes me feel free and happy.

My favorite movie is about a group of friends who go on an adventure. The scenes are colorful, and the music makes the story even more exciting. It teaches me about teamwork, trust, and facing challenges. I have watched it many times because it always makes me smile.

I have a brown dog named Max who is very playful and friendly. He has shiny fur, big ears, and loves running around in the yard. He often follows me when I ride my bicycle in the park. Max is my best animal friend because he makes every day fun.

My favorite mountain is tall and covered with green trees and wildflowers. In the morning, clouds surround its top, making it look magical and peaceful. I like hiking there with my friends to enjoy the fresh air. This mountain is special to me because it reminds me of my childhood trips.

There is a small bookshop in my neighborhood that I visit often. The shelves are full of colorful books about travel, history, and adventure. The shop owner is kind and always recommends interesting books for me. I love this shop because it feels warm and inspires me to read more.
Mục tiêu học tập
#1 Thực hành nghe và nói ở cấp độ cao hơn; nghe, xử lý và lặp lại thay vì đọc lại.
#2 Trải nghiệm và thực hành cách triển khai một bài nói dạng miêu tả theo bố cục
Giới thiệu đối tượng
Miêu tả ngoại hình/đặc điểm
Miêu tả tính cách/chức năng/đặc điểm nổi bật
Cảm xúc hoặc ý nghĩa đối với người viết
Cách học level nâng cao (đã tương đối thông thạo ghép âm)
Học nhanh qua nội dung và cách đọc (chỉ hướng dẫn qua, không học từng câu)
*TH 1: Tự tin nắm hết nội dung | Thực hành toàn bộ nội dung 10 lần; mỗi lần 100 điểm.
*TH 2: Chưa tự tin nắm hết nội dung | Học và thực hành từng phần, mỗi phần thực hành 50 điểm. Thực hành toàn bộ nội dung 6 lần; mỗi lần 100 điểm.
Các dạng bài tập
Mỗi A(n) là 5 câu hỏi với 1 đáp án đúng và 1 đáp án sai. Nghe toàn bộ và lặp lại đáp án đúng.
Mỗi B(n) là 5 câu hỏi yes/no (Đúng) và 5 câu hỏi yes/no (Sai). Nghe và trả lời Yes nếu đúng và ngược lại.
Bài tập ở phần phụ lục.
